## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, before/after behavior, and scope; link a real issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the exact commands and observed results, the changed end-to-end flow exercised,
and any skipped or unavailable checks. For behavior changes, include the observed
test-first failure and passing regression; for docs, give the validation equivalent.
Name model/data/source versions and actual budgets when reporting an experiment.

## Risks and limits

State behavioral, compatibility, data, and cost risks relevant to this change;
distinguish measured behavior from planned work. Identify blockers or unverified areas.

## Documentation and review lessons

Link updated guidance, status, or reports. For review fixes, name the failure modes
addressed and the durable rule added, or explain why no guidance update is needed.
Confirm the full diff and relevant review context were inspected.
